lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6Co2 (Mn3Co) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Co and Mn centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Co is surrounded by 12 Mn neighbors, while Mn has 4 Co and 8 Mn neighbors, with distances ranging from 2.5604 to 2.6699 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner, edge, and face sharing among Mn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, with corner and edge sharing between Co- and Mn-centered polyhedra.
